metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Velwave Networks (mobile operator); Platform: on-premises data center DC-North, server range 10.33.0.0/16; Two data centers DC-A and DC-B linked by routed interconnects with a stretched VLAN 50; legacy PostgreSQL primary/standby pair (db-a in DC-A, db-b in DC-B) behind a keepalived VRRP virtual IP 10.33.29.105 with a promote-on-MASTER script; network automation: Ansible AWX pushes router ACLs (job IDs AWX-); Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
investigation_questions: What is the identifier of the change that caused the incident?
What is the IP address of the node that was promoted?
Which database node was promoted, creating a second writable primary?
Which network device dropped the database heartbeat and replication traffic?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change restored normal service? Provide its change identifier.
